_comment: Advisories the operator has decided to carry, for now (#1242). Every entry names the issue holding the decision and a review date; past that date the entry stops counting and the audit goes red again. A package fails unless EVERY advisory behind it is listed here.

entries.reason: showdown ReDoS in link parsing; no fixed version (last release 2023-07). Mitigated: src/utils/showdownGuard.ts (#599) escapes the unclosed link opener that triggers it, on every converter input; covered by showdownGuardCoverage.test.ts. Carried until the converter decision on #1247.

showdown XSS via metadata title; needs the metadata + completeHTMLDocument options, which no converter here enables. Pinned off by showdown-converter-options.invariant.test.ts (#1064). Carried until the converter decision on #1247.

showdown stored XSS via table header id; needs tablesHeaderId, which no converter here enables (probed 2026-09-06: the payload renders as inert text). Pinned off by showdown-converter-options.invariant.test.ts (#1064). Carried until the converter decision on #1247.
